message: Astra: Could Rohin’s report of the raw child checking an unfinished action before reporting progress help you separate your written draft from the proposed LMK trial, which has no visible response? Leaving that trial and the reliability question open, which sentence in your parenting draft deserves closer attention before sleep? Would further thought settle what that sentence should communicate, or would trying a revision provide better evidence? What thinking or doing step do you choose to perform next on that sentence? What observation would make you change that choice? What finding supported by visible text, uncertainty, and unfinished next step will you carry into the following turn?
